language.name: Haitian Creole
language.canonical_note: One canonical lang:hat course with HT/BS/CL/CU/DO/US contexts; no country duplicates.

needs: ou, ch, j, y and w
orthography_pronunciation.voice_strategy: No guaranteed browser TTS in canonical inventory; audio remains explicitly synthetic/fallback and must never claim native recording.

register_pragmatics: French code-switching described without treating Creole as deficient

CEFR_progression.A1: sound-spelling, greetings, se, basic predicates and determiners
CEFR_progression.A2: TMA markers, quantity, directions, plans and requests
CEFR_progression.B1: TMA sequencing, relative clauses, reporting and narration
CEFR_progression.B2: focus, modality, passive strategies, clause chaining and register
CEFR_progression.C1: academic synthesis, mediation and calibrated stance
CEFR_progression.C2: scope, implication, rhetoric, proverb/idiom, genre transformation and precision
